events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Enduring Wit
angles.copy: From silly walks to hotel mayhem, John Cleese has given us decades of iconic British comedy. Wishing the legendary Python a very happy 87th birthday!

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1968, The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album'.

angles.name: Iconic Release
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece that still sparks debate. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: A Legend Remembered
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, the world lost a true showman. Remembering Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul', marking a significant artistic shift.

angles.name: Influential Album
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. An album that pushed boundaries and set new standards for pop music. Which track stands out for you?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles' co-founder, John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, we lost a voice that inspired generations. Remembering John Lennon, whose music and message of peace continue to resonate globally.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Legendary English singer-songwriter David Bowie, born on this day in 1947, would have celebrated his 80th birthday.

angles.name: Starman's 80th
angles.copy: Eighty years ago today, a star was born. Remembering the iconic David Bowie, the ultimate chameleon whose influence on music and culture is still felt.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: American rock and roll icon Elvis Presley, born on this day in 1935, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday.

angles.name: Long Live the King
angles.copy: Ninety-two years ago, the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, was born. His music continues to define an era and get us all shook up!

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: English guitarist, songwriter, and record producer Jimmy Page, best known as the founder of Led Zeppelin, celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Guitar God's Birthday
angles.copy: Stairway to heaven and beyond! Wishing the legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page a very happy 83rd birthday today.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Sir Rod Stewart, known for his distinctive raspy voice and hits across rock and pop, celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: From the Faces to solo stardom, Sir Rod Stewart's iconic voice has graced the airwaves for decades. Happy 82nd birthday to a true music legend!

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic lead singer of the English ska band Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Madness Frontman
angles.copy: Our house, in the middle of our street... and it's Suggs' 66th birthday! Wishing the Madness frontman a very happy one.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for his blue-eyed soul hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Wherever He Lays His Hat
angles.copy: The smooth voice behind some of the 80s' biggest hits is celebrating! Happy 71st birthday to the one and only Paul Young.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: American country music icon Dolly Parton, born on this day in 1946, would have celebrated her 81st birthday.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Dolly Parton on what would have been her 81st birthday. Her music and spirit continue to shine bright.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: English singer, songwriter, and Take That frontman Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Take That's Main Man
angles.copy: He's written countless hits and led one of the biggest boy bands in history. Happy 56th birthday to the brilliant Gary Barlow!

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer and songwriter Billy Ocean, known for his string of international R&B and pop hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: When the going gets tough, the tough get going... to wish Billy Ocean a very happy 77th birthday! The smooth voice of 80s soul.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame first induction
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the first ever induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame was held in New York City.

angles.name: Making History
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago, rock history was made with the very first Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame induction ceremony. Who was in that legendary inaugural class?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Mark Owen, a member of the iconic pop group Take That, celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Take That Member
angles.copy: Another Take That legend celebrating a birthday! Wishing Mark Owen a very happy 55th today. What's your favourite Mark moment?

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their famous impromptu rooftop concert on the Apple Corps building in London, their final public performance.

angles.name: Legendary Last Gig
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert. The ultimate send-off for the Fab Four. Were you watching (or listening)?

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: English singer, drummer, songwriter, and record producer Phil Collins, known for his work with Genesis and a successful solo career, celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: In The Air Tonight
angles.copy: From Genesis to solo superstardom, Phil Collins has given us some incredible tracks. Wishing the drumming legend a very happy 76th birthday!

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: British actor Hugh Grant, known for his roles in romantic comedies and more recently, acclaimed dramatic performances, celebrates his 67th birthday.

angles.name: British Charm
angles.copy: From 'Notting Hill' to 'Love Actually', Hugh Grant has charmed audiences worldwide. Wishing the British acting icon a very happy 67th birthday!

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, actor, and record producer Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: Pop Superstar
angles.copy: He's brought SexyBack and so much more! Happy 46th birthday to the one and only Justin Timberlake. What's your favourite JT track?
